title: Independently verify PR2942 owner-to-recursive-cost bridge
body:
PR2942 changes four helper widths from nine to eight, but its proposed recursive saving depends on the literal owner allocation and every unused owner remainder. This adds an independently implemented bridge from both exact provider words through all 271,728 helper placements to the complete local-and-idle rank histogram, with 86 private cleanup names included in the stated 66,808-family namespace.

The exact complete bill is favorable at the pinned PR2930 guarded headline. Its margin is fragile: the single rank-14 residual costs over 3.21 times that margin; in the fixed moment model, one extra rank-four child fits while rank five already exceeds one. This is a conditional cost tolerance, not a tariff for physical buffers or a new kappa.

Verification: explicit GF(2)^9 subspaces and exact warp maps; 1,332 source windows; 149,184 bins; 740 shared-family lifetime transitions; separately implemented positive-binomial rational bounds. Registered Python3.12, optimized replay, 31 mathematical test methods, 16 owner-corruption controls, read-only Git-free optimized Python3.14 and all 34 committed file bytes pass. Written proofs, exact pins, controls and receipts are in `research/normal45-owner-cost-bridge`.

Scope: finite frame/whole-owner/local-and-idle accounting and namespace count. Native operator realization, full physical storage, coefficient/prefix/precision/tape costs, outer admission and all-size/compiler hypotheses remain separate. PR2960 covers the different simultaneous dirty-input algebra obligation. Newer rewritten/codimension-two words are outside this frozen-source check. No selected-frontier change or independent human/formal-kernel proof is claimed.

Sources: PR2942 `a027b0f6`, PR2917 `224bd5e5`, PR2908 `51309592`, comparator PR2930 `81f3b5d1`.
